label: Wisenet X 5MP vandal dome IP camera
description: 5 MP vandal-resistant outdoor dome from the Wisenet X series with a 10/100/1000 RJ45 port. PoE 802.3af Class 3, max 12.95 W, with 12 VDC and 24 VAC alternatives.
notes: PoE class 802.3af Class 3, 12.95 W (the datasheet quotes 12.95 W as the PoE maximum, i.e. it uses the whole class). Wired only, but gigabit. Rare case of a camera that also takes 24 VAC, so legacy installs can bypass the PoE switch entirely.
